name: How can I maximize storage in a small bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing storage in a small bathroom requires clever design choices. Consider installing a wall-mounted or floating vanity to free up floor space, or a vanity with built-in drawers and shelving. Recessed medicine cabinets are excellent for discreet storage without protruding into the room. Utilize vertical space with tall, narrow storage units or open shelving above the toilet. Niche inserts within the shower wall provide functional storage for toiletries. Over-the-door organizers or hooks can also add quick, accessible storage for towels and robes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small bathroom storage with floating vanities, recessed medicine cabinets, vertical shelving, shower niches, and over-the-door organizers.
